questions.q_en: In one minute, how does your bioreactor keep the bacteria in but let the protein out?
questions.q_zh: 請用一分鐘說明，你們的生物反應器怎麼把細菌留住、卻讓蛋白質出去？
questions.a_en: The culture circulates inside 11 hollow fibers whose walls have 0.2 µm pores, so cells stay in the lumen and secreted protein crosses to the shell side. We checked it two ways. ACC deaminase read 10.7 µg/mL in the lumen and 10.5 on the shell side, and shell-side medium grew no colonies while the lumen plate did. The pore size is the mechanism; the plating is only two single tests.
questions.a_zh: 菌液在 11 根中空纖維內循環，纖維壁有 0.2 µm 的孔，所以細胞留在管腔側，分泌的蛋白質則穿過到殼側。我們用兩種方式檢查：ACC deaminase 在管腔側是 10.7 µg/mL、殼側是 10.5 µg/mL；殼側培養液的平板沒長出菌落，管腔側的平板有。機制靠孔徑，平板證據只有兩次單次實驗。
questions.trap_en: Saying the membrane is proven fully safe. We have two single platings with no log reduction.
questions.trap_zh: 說膜已被證明完全安全。我們只有兩次單次平板，沒有對數減量。
questions.basis: judge pattern: explain the core device in your own words

questions.q_en: Why a hollow-fiber perfusion bioreactor, instead of releasing the bacteria on the roots or using a normal stirred tank?
questions.q_zh: 為什麼選中空纖維灌流反應器，而不是把細菌放在根部，或用一般的攪拌槽？
questions.a_en: Our first plan was engineered bacteria living on the roots, but once released their dose and spread cannot be controlled. So we keep the organism in a machine and send out only its product. Hollow fiber suits a secreted protein because the wall holds the cells and passes the protectant. It also scales by copying one module. We did not compare it with a stirred tank on cost.
questions.a_zh: 我們最初的計畫是讓基因改造細菌住在根部，但一旦釋放，劑量和擴散就無法控制。所以我們把生物留在機器裡，只送出它的產物。中空纖維適合分泌型蛋白，因為膜壁擋住細胞、讓保護物通過，也能靠複製單一模組來擴大規模。我們沒有在成本上和攪拌槽比較過。
questions.trap_en: Giving only the cost or convenience reason. The main reason on the wiki is biosafety.
questions.trap_zh: 只講成本或方便。wiki 寫的主要理由是生物安全。
questions.basis: judge pattern: why this design over the obvious alternative

questions.q_en: How did you arrive at 263 mL/min and a TMP of 0.30 bar as the operating point?
questions.q_zh: 你們怎麼得出 263 mL/min、TMP 0.30 bar 這個操作點？
questions.a_en: We read pressure and flow by instrument on 16 August, once with the module and once with a plain tube, so we could subtract the plumbing, which was 46 to 55% of the drop. The net module drop matched Hagen–Poiseuille theory. At 263 mL/min the shear is about 4060 s⁻¹, mid-window for the manufacturer, and TMP non-uniformity is 28% at 0.30 bar. The 0.30 bar is a chosen target, not what we ran.
questions.a_zh: 8 月 16 日我們用儀器讀壓力和流量，一次裝模組、一次換成一般管子，這樣才能扣掉管路，管路佔壓降的 46 至 55%。扣掉後模組本身的壓降符合 Hagen–Poiseuille 理論。263 mL/min 時剪切率約 4060 s⁻¹，位於廠商建議範圍中段，TMP 0.30 bar 時不均勻度為 28%。0.30 bar 是設定的目標值，不是我們實際跑的壓力。
questions.trap_en: Presenting 0.30 bar as a measured running pressure.
questions.trap_zh: 把 0.30 bar 說成實際量到的運轉壓力。
questions.basis: judge pattern: how was the key parameter chosen

questions.q_en: Did you ever actually run the bioreactor at your recommended operating point?
questions.q_zh: 你們有真的用建議的操作點運轉過反應器嗎？
questions.a_en: Not exactly. The recommended point is 263 mL/min at a TMP of 0.30 bar, but the runs fed about 300 to 390 mL/min, and in the sampling record the flow was about 305 mL/min with a mean TMP near 0.03 bar. TMP reached 0.16 bar only for 60 seconds while the pinch valve was closed. The operating point comes from water calibration; the runs sit above its flow and far below its pressure.
questions.a_zh: 不完全是。建議的操作點是 263 mL/min、TMP 0.30 bar，但實際運轉進料約 300 至 390 mL/min；在取樣紀錄中流量約 305 mL/min，平均 TMP 約 0.03 bar。只有夾管閥關閉的那 60 秒，TMP 才到 0.16 bar。操作點來自用水做的校正，實際運轉的流量比它高、壓力遠比它低。
questions.trap_en: Claiming the runs were at the recommended point. Judges can read the sampling trace.
questions.trap_zh: 聲稱實際運轉就在建議操作點。評審看得到取樣的壓力曲線。
questions.basis: honesty probe: spec versus what was run

questions.q_en: Your design flux is 2 LMH but your runs drew 36 to 72 LMH. Is that above your own fouling limit?
questions.q_zh: 你們的設計通量是 2 LMH，但實際運轉抽了 36 至 72 LMH。這不是超過你們自己算的積垢上限嗎？
questions.a_en: Yes, in part. The scaling table uses a design flux of 2 LMH against a modelled critical flux of 46 LMH. The runs drew 12 to 24 mL/min through 200 cm², which is 36 to 72 LMH, so run 5 at 72 and run 7 at 51 (Digital Twin numbering) were above 46. The extra pressure still rose only from 1.9 to 4.4 kPa over 77 hours, from one module in one run. The 46 is a model for cells in water.
questions.a_zh: 部分是的。擴大規模表用的設計通量是 2 LMH，模型算出的臨界通量是 46 LMH。實際運轉透過 200 cm² 抽 12 至 24 mL/min，也就是 36 至 72 LMH，所以第 5 次的 72 與第 7 次的 51（數位孿生的編號）都高於 46。不過額外壓力在 77 小時內只從 1.9 升到 4.4 kPa，而且只有一個模組、一次運轉。46 這個數字是以水中細胞為前提的模型值。
questions.trap_en: Quoting J/Jcrit of 0.04 as if it described the runs. That number is for the 2 LMH design flux.
questions.trap_zh: 把 J/Jcrit 0.04 當成實際運轉的數字。那是 2 LMH 設計通量的值。
questions.basis: validate: design numbers versus run numbers

questions.q_en: Your pages give two different pressure drops at 263 mL/min. Which one is right?
questions.q_zh: 你們的頁面在 263 mL/min 給了兩個不同的壓降，哪一個才對？
questions.a_en: The hardware page tables 0.084 bar, 0.90 times Hagen–Poiseuille theory. Digital Twin, Biomanufacturing and Development quote 0.096 bar, 1.03 times. Both cite the same 16 August water series, and the wiki does not say why they differ. I would say plainly that we have two values. Both put the module close to theory for 11 open fibers, so no fiber is blocked.
questions.a_zh: 硬體頁的表格寫 0.084 bar，是 Hagen–Poiseuille 理論的 0.90 倍；數位孿生、生物製造與開發頁寫 0.096 bar，是 1.03 倍。兩者都引用 8 月 16 日同一組水的實驗，wiki 沒有說明為什麼不同。我會直接說我們有兩個數值，兩者都顯示模組接近 11 根纖維全通的理論值，沒有纖維被堵住。
questions.trap_en: Picking one number and hoping the judge has not seen the other page.
questions.trap_zh: 挑一個數字講，希望評審沒看過另一頁。
questions.basis: cross-page conflict on the same measurement

questions.q_en: The bioreactor page reports DNPH activity of 0.037 mU/mL, but Results says about 30 nmol per mL per hour. Which is it?
questions.q_zh: 反應器頁的 DNPH 活性寫 0.037 mU/mL，結果頁卻寫約 30 nmol/mL/h，到底是哪個？
questions.a_en: They differ by roughly a thousandfold, and only the Results figure fits our stated specific activity. With one unit as 1 µmol per hour, as the bioreactor page defines it, 30 nmol per mL per hour is about 30 mU/mL. Divided by about 6 µg/mL of enzyme that gives roughly 5 U/mg, inside the 2.3 to 8.3 quoted. 0.037 mU/mL would give about 0.006 U/mg, so it looks like a unit slip.
questions.a_zh: 兩者差約一千倍，只有結果頁的數字符合我們寫的比活性。依反應器頁的定義，1 單位是每小時釋出 1 µmol，30 nmol/mL/h 約等於 30 mU/mL。除以約 6 µg/mL 的酵素，大約是 5 U/mg，落在所寫的 2.3 至 8.3 之內。0.037 mU/mL 只會得到約 0.006 U/mg，所以看起來是單位寫錯。
questions.trap_en: Defending 0.037 mU/mL. Also note that Development converts 30.9 nmol/mL/h to 0.52 mU/mL with a per-minute unit, a third convention.
questions.trap_zh: 替 0.037 mU/mL 辯護。另外開發頁把 30.9 nmol/mL/h 換成 0.52 mU/mL，用的是每分鐘的單位，是第三種算法。
questions.basis: unit conflict; checked by dividing by ELISA concentration

questions.q_en: How strong is your containment evidence, and how big are B. subtilis cells compared with your 0.2 µm pores?
questions.q_zh: 你們的封閉性證據有多強？枯草桿菌細胞和 0.2 µm 的孔相比有多大？
questions.a_en: It is two single platings: 2 mL of shell-side liquid in June, and a lumen against shell pair after 24 h at 37 °C where the lumen grew and the shell did not. There were no replicates, no recorded detection limit and no log reduction, so it is preliminary. Cell size is quoted three ways: 0.25 to 1.0 µm on Safety, 0.8 to 2.0 µm wide on Results, and the bioreactor page says pores are smaller than any cell.
questions.a_zh: 證據是兩次單次平板：6 月取 2 mL 殼側液體，以及一組 37 °C 培養 24 小時的管腔側對殼側比較，管腔長菌、殼側沒有。沒有重複、沒有記錄偵測極限、也沒有對數減量，所以只是初步證據。細胞大小有三種寫法：安全頁寫 0.25 至 1.0 µm，結果頁寫寬 0.8 至 2.0 µm，反應器頁則說孔比任何細胞都小。
questions.trap_en: Saying the membrane was tested many times. It was plated twice, once each.
questions.trap_zh: 說膜測過很多次。其實只平板了兩次，各一次。

questions.q_en: Your Safety page says you have automated TMP alerts and droplet leak detection. Do you?
questions.q_zh: 安全頁說你們有自動 TMP 警報和漏液偵測，真的有嗎？
questions.a_en: Partly. A pressure trip at 0.70 bar is in the firmware and was armed in the 77-hour run, peak 0.57 bar, so it never fired. The bioreactor page still calls the pressure alarm and droplet sensor planned, and no droplet sensor is on the cost list. In integrated run 3 a valve broke at 38 h and feed pressure rose from 0.19 to 0.37 bar while TMP stayed flat, so pressure alone missed a real leak.
questions.a_zh: 部分有。0.70 bar 的壓力跳脫已寫在韌體裡，77 小時那次運轉時待命，最高只到 0.57 bar，所以從未動作。反應器頁仍把壓力警報和漏液感測器寫成規劃中，成本表裡也沒有漏液感測器。整合第 3 次運轉在 38 小時有閥斷裂，進料壓從 0.19 升到 0.37 bar，TMP 卻沒變，所以光靠壓力沒抓到真正的漏液。
questions.trap_en: Reading the Safety page aloud as if every detector is built and tested.
questions.trap_zh: 照著安全頁念，好像所有偵測器都已做好並測過。
questions.basis: honesty probe: what is built versus what is described

questions.q_en: What else can cross a 0.2 µm membrane besides your protein, and what happens if a fiber breaks?
questions.q_zh: 0.2 µm 的膜除了你們的蛋白質，還有什麼能穿過？如果纖維破了會怎樣？
questions.a_en: A 0.2 µm pore sorts by size, so vesicles and debris of 20 to 200 nm, medium components and the roughly 36 kDa enzyme all cross. Only whole cells are held back. So the shell side is treated as live culture until a plate grows nothing, and the manual asks for plating after every membrane change. The pressure trip only watches for over-pressure; a sudden-drop alarm for a broken fiber is still planned.
questions.a_zh: 0.2 µm 的孔只依大小篩選，所以 20 至 200 nm 的囊泡與碎屑、培養基成分，以及約 36 kDa 的酵素都會穿過，只有完整細胞被擋住。因此殼側液體在平板確認沒長菌之前都當作活菌處理，手冊也要求每次換膜後要做平板。壓力跳脫只監看過高壓力；偵測纖維斷裂的壓力驟降警報仍在規劃中。
questions.basis: boundary probe: what does the barrier not stop

questions.q_en: How did expert feedback change your hardware?
questions.q_zh: 專家的意見怎麼改變了你們的硬體？
questions.a_en: Four changes trace to reviews. Prof. Chang saw nothing pushing product across the wall, so we added the servo pinch valve; he also asked for flow and pressure monitoring, a smaller membrane and the DNPH assay. Teacher He of Owl Lab replaced our PCA9685 driver with STS3215 servos and proposed the single mainboard, which also ended the unstable pressure readings. Dr. Brophy's advice gave us the membrane instead of a kill switch.
questions.a_zh: 有四項改變來自審查意見。張嘉修教授指出設計裡沒有東西把產物推過膜壁，所以我們加了伺服夾管閥；他也要求監測流量與壓力、改用較小的膜，並採用 DNPH 檢測。Owl Lab 的何老師把我們的 PCA9685 驅動板換成 STS3215 伺服馬達，並提出單一主機板，連帶解決了壓力讀值不穩的問題。Brophy 博士的建議讓我們用膜取代自殺開關。
questions.trap_en: Listing the experts without saying what physically changed.
questions.trap_zh: 只列專家名字，沒說明實際改了什麼。

questions.q_en: Why build your own instead of buying a commercial system, and did you compare against one?
questions.q_zh: 為什麼自己做、不買商業系統？你們有和商業系統比較過嗎？
kw_zh: 光度計約 BioDrop 一半價
questions.a_en: We did not run a side-by-side with a commercial perfusion system, so I cannot give a performance comparison. We bought the hollow-fiber module, US$245, and built the pumps, sensing, valves and dashboard around it. For the photometer, nobody sells an in-line OD600 instrument. The Slim costs US$235 against about US$470 for the BioDrop, which cannot sit in the loop. Known bioreactor materials come to US$1022.67.
questions.a_zh: 我們沒有和商業灌流系統做並排比較，所以無法給出性能對照。我們買了中空纖維模組（US$245），其餘的幫浦、感測、閥門和儀表板都是自己做的。光度計方面，市面上沒有在線 OD600 儀器，Slim 成本 US$235，BioDrop 約 US$470 且無法放進循環管路。反應器已知材料成本為 US$1022.67。
questions.trap_en: Inventing a price or performance comparison with a commercial system. None is on the wiki.
questions.trap_zh: 編造與商業系統的價格或性能比較，wiki 上沒有。
questions.basis: judge pattern: why not buy it
